intro: One small pack of kerepek ubi (30 g) has about 160 kcal. Almost half the calories come from the frying oil soaked up by the cassava slices.
diet: Yes, once in a while and in a small pack. Kerepek doesn't fill you up much, so it's easy to eat a lot. One big pack can go above 500 kcal, same as a plate of rice. If you buy a big pack, portion it into a bowl first.
tips: Buy small packs, not the big pack 'to keep at home'.
Pour some into a small bowl and keep the rest. Don't eat straight from the packet.
Eat it with fruit or cucumber so you feel fuller with fewer calories.

swap.name: 1 handful boiled groundnuts (kacang tanah rebus)
swap.why: Still salty and fun to munch, but less oil and a bit of protein to keep you fuller.

faq.a: If you make it yourself, you can control the oil and salt. Try baking it or using an air fryer with a little oil.

faq.q: Is spicy kerepek ubi higher in calories?
faq.a: Only slightly higher because of the sugar and seasoning. The main difference is still the pack size.

faq.q: How long does kerepek ubi last?
faq.a: Usually a few weeks if kept in an airtight container in a dry place. Check the expiry date on the pack.
